chapter: Orion Tutorial - Consolidated Agent Curriculum and Design Patterns

concepts.title: 1.1 LLM Setup
concepts.description: Configuring the core language model client, establishing provider environments, and adjusting structural hyperparameters like temperature.

concepts.title: 1.2 Tools & Shell Command Execution
concepts.description: Defining executable capabilities (file operations, shell subprocesses) using tools like `@tool + subprocess` that the model can call to interact with external environments.

concepts.title: 1.3 Agent Graph & Smart Routing
concepts.description: Constructing the stateful runtime network mapping out nodes, control flows, and conditional execution paths using `add_conditional_edges`.

concepts.title: 1.4 Structured Planning
concepts.description: Leveraging structural orchestration (such as Agent Mode's planning steps via `with_structured_output`) to construct sequential execution strategies before generation.

concepts.title: 1.6 System Prompt
concepts.description: Structuring high-priority system prompt constraints to control agent persona, logic safety, and output strictness.

concepts.title: 1.7 Streaming
concepts.description: Handling real-time token delivery streaming loops from the graph execution layer directly to user interfaces.

concepts.title: 1.8 Multi Turn Conversation
concepts.description: Maintaining stateful memory layers and conversational context buffers across sequential user interactions.

concepts.title: 2.1 Structured Output & File Generation
concepts.description: Enforcing deterministic model formatting targets such as JSON schemas, Pydantic objects, or typed system responses.

concepts.title: 2.2 AI Code Review with Retry Limit
concepts.description: Implementing inner-loop parsing catch blocks, code review suggestions, and conditional edges + counters to capture errors and route them back for self-correction.

concepts.title: 2.3 Dynamic Rules
concepts.description: Injecting shifting validation profiles or guardrails based on state changes or specific file paths discovered at runtime.

concepts.title: 2.4 Inline Edit
concepts.description: Targeting discrete blocks within pre-existing structures to execute precise diff patches without full rewrites.

concepts.title: 3.1 Codebase RAG & Semantic Code Search
concepts.description: Indexing system codebases using abstractions like FAISS + retriever tools (`@codebase`, `@file`) to provide accurate contextual grounding.

concepts.title: 3.2 Orchestrator State
concepts.description: Managing complex global state contexts to control cross-boundary scopes within hierarchical multi-agent tasks.

concepts.title: 3.3 Multi-Agent Code Generation per File
concepts.description: Dividing operational scope among specialized actor nodes with distinct capabilities, multi-file edits, and state transitions.

concepts.title: 3.4 Human Approval Gate
concepts.description: Setting explicit graph breakpoints using `interrupt + Command` to pause execution for a 'Review before applying' validation gate.

concepts.title: 3.5 Parallel File Generation
concepts.description: Branching execution paths using the `Send` API + reducers to process parallel agents or worktrees concurrently before merging state.

concepts.title: 3.6 State Checkpointing & Time Travel
concepts.description: Leveraging `MemorySaver` and thread configurations for session persistence, allowing users to look back into history or re-route alternate path executions.
